summary: Two-project integration brief: annunimas-human-tenant provides an Obsidian-compatible interface for scanning, parsing, linking, and classifying private human knowledge; upstream Annunimas supplies the core memory contract and Mnemosyne integration on which the tenant currently depends. Their shared autonomous-agent safety boundary is that private human material must retain provenance and explicit authority/status, remain untrusted until classified, and never be silently promoted, moved, overwritten, deleted, or converted into high-risk action without review and applicable autonomy governance. Recommended integration: replace the tenant's direct Annunimas path dependencies with a versioned tenant-facing memory adapter that persists MemoryRecord values while preserving source path, authority, status, confidence, and review-required metadata. Tenant risk: MemoryStore::store currently serializes each record and discards it, so scan_vault can appear to ingest knowledge without persisting any memory. Upstream risk: the retained workspace member and direct compatibility seam can diverge from the private tenant implementation, creating ambiguous ownership and inconsistent safety behavior until compatibility removal is completed. The declared clean-tree check passed; inspection was read-only and created no artifacts.
